description: LLM model configuration for the chatbot two-model pipeline and statement categorization

notes.primary_model: Merchant name cleaning (pass 1 & arbiter) + chatbot intent parser + transaction categorization.
notes.secondary_model: Optional: merchant name cleaning (pass 2 ensemble). Leave empty to disable ensemble cleaning — not required.
notes.financial_analysis_model: Chatbot answers + self-summarization of long conversations. Handles the entire chat pipeline after intent parsing.
